## Extensions


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| tail | parent: pelvis; pattern: tail_{index:02}; segments: 2; 4; rule: Shared low-count mammal/reptile tail; no weapon hit authority. |
| stinger | parent: pelvis; pattern: stinger_{index:02}; segments: 6; rule: Skarvex only. Tip carries socket_vfx_stinger. Tail cannot implement combat range or damage. |
| serpent tail | parent: pelvis; pattern: tail_{index:02}; segments: 8; rule: Sylvex replaces legs with a grounded tail chain; custom profile, no humanoid gait retarget. |
| wing | parent: spine_03; pattern: wing_{index:02}_{side}; segments: 3; rule: Aethryon shoulder mantle, separate from two weapon arms. Folded locomotion; no permanent flight or anatomy change. |
| ear | parent: head; pattern: ear_{index:02}_{side}; segments: 1; 3; rule: One for ordinary mammals; three for long hare ears. Keep expression poses additive. |
| hood | parent: neck; pattern: hood_{index:02}_{side}; segments: 2; rule: Cobra hood panels; limited spread with zero body scale change. |
| feather cape | parent: spine_03; pattern: feather_cape_{index:02}_{side}; segments: 3; rule: Raven/owl secondary feather motion; no replacement of weapon arms. |
| scarf | parent: neck; pattern: scarf_{index:02}; segments: 3; rule: Secondary motion only, keep clear of face and weapon silhouette. |
| horns antlers shell fins | parent: head or spine_03 as anatomy dictates; pattern: rigid mesh; no extra deform bone by default; segments: ; rule: Rigid rhino horns/stag antlers parent to head; turtle shell and dorsal fin to torso. Deform only with a documented topology exception. |


## Naming

lower_snake_case; l/r are anatomical sides; indices are two digits; no Blender .001 suffixes

## Hurtbox Policy

Anchors support presentation/debug alignment only; v1.17 resolver is non-spatial and no damage/collision logic is introduced.

## Extension Policy

Additions must not rename or reorder shared semantic bones. Unmapped extension tracks stay in hero-specific animation libraries. Horns/wings/ears/tails never silently transform across evolution forms.
